body.checker: units.confined (norm of 1 + zeta to F(4)); units.pyramid_confined (every eigenvalue of the pyramid, as a norm to F(4))
excluded_seen: every eligible prime up to 301: Fable and the orchestrator checked p < 200, and the sixth pilot's agent listed where rule 90 is confined to the cubes for m <= 301

hypotheses.criterion: predicted == observed at every prime of the grid
hypotheses.pyramids: every predicted pyramid is confined and every neighbour is not

body.source: Claude Fable, consulted 2026-10-20 on the m = 37 cubes (docs/consultations.md)
body.statement: For each prime p = 5 (mod 8) with 2 a primitive root, 302 <= p < 20000: rule 90 is confined to the cubes at p (1 + zeta is a cube in F(2^(p-1))) exactly when eps^h lies in Z[sqrt p]. At p = i^2 + 1 below 10000 where it holds, the pyramid with rings at radii 2, 4, ..., i/2 - 1 is confined to the cubes, and the pyramid without its largest ring is not.
body.title: Fable's unit criterion for rule 90's cube confinement, and its pyramid rules
